newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli police wound Arab youth in East Jerusalem.
newsitem.headline: Israeli police wound Arab youth in East Jerusalem.

text.p: An Israeli paramilitary policeman shot and wounded on Thursday a Palestinian youth who fought with him in Arab East Jerusalem's Old City, a police official said.

"Near the Damascus Gate, a Border Police force arrested an Arab youth for throwing stones at an (Israeli) Egged bus," said police spokesman Shmulik Ben-Ruby. "The Arab, under arrest, attacked a policeman, who fired at him and hit him in the leg."
The Palestinian youth was lightly injured, Ben-Ruby said.
